review_candidates.description: Job Description Are you passionate about healthcare innovation and cutting-edge technology? Agilent is seeking a highly driven, professional with a strong knowledge in Digital Pathology to accelerate the adoption of our Digital Pathology solutions. In this strategic role, you will lead sales activities, funnel developing activities together with key internal stakeholders to engage customers across clinical and research environments, and articulate Agilent’s unique value proposition within the rapidly expanding Digital Pathology market. Your technical and commercial expertise will support advanced pre‑sales engagements, including customer presentations, product demonstrations, and collaboration with pathologists, laboratory leaders, and healthcare administrators. You will confidently guide discussions around workflow optimization, digital transformation, image analysis, and AI‑enabled pathology tools together with internal stakeholders. We are seeking a self‑starter with a strong customer-focused mindset, that works proactively internally and externally and has a proven history of building funnel momentum and delivering results. Responsibilities Drive Agilent's Digital Pathology growth from prospecting through to close by co-coordinating with internal stakeholders. Identify, cultivate, and expand relationships with pathologists, laboratory directors, clinical leaders, healthcare administrators and IT managers. Partner with strategic collaborators to broaden market penetration and quickly scale adoption. Actively map, track, and develop opportunities within Agilent and competitor-installed bases, identify replacement, upgrade, or expansion opportunities and building targeted strategies to displace incumbent solutions. Develop deep understanding of competitor offerings, positioning, and installed footprint within the territory to effectively differentiate Agilent solutions and influence customer decision-making. Work cross-functionally with field sales, product management, field marketing, and implementation teams (FSEs, Applications) to strengthen the full sales cycle to ensure smooth onboarding and long-term customer success. Ensure structured and high-quality handover to implementation and service teams, including clear documentation of customer requirements, expectations, and workflow specifications. Assess customer laboratory workflows in detail and align solutions to operational, IT, and diagnostic requirements to ensure successful adoption. Collaborate closely with service and implementation teams to leverage insights from existing installations (both Agilent and competitors) to inform sales strategy and improve win rates. Maintain strong pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, and consistent CRM (Salesforce) management. Remain engaged post-sales to support early adoption, customer satisfaction, and identification of expansion opportunities. Represent Agilent at industry conferences, customer events, and professional forums to promote Digital Pathology solutions and drive commercial impact. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field; a Master’s degree or PhD is preferred. Minimum of 3 years of sales experience in healthcare SaaS and/or pathology imaging hardware. Experience with LIS, IMS, image management platforms, digital pathology scanners, or similar solutions is preferred. Please note: experience limited to radiology imaging is not considered relevant for this role. Demonstrated success in digital or software driven sales environments, with the ability to rapidly identify opportunities and convert complex customer needs into solutions. Good understanding of IT infrastructure, system integrations (LIS/HIS), cybersecurity, and data management. Familiarity with H&E, IHC, microscopy, pathology imaging systems, scanners, image‑management platforms, and/or AI‑enabled workflow applications. Strong ability to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders; effective working across diverse teams and geographies. Excellent analytical skills and proficiency with Salesforce.com or other digital sales tools. Highly self-motivated and organized, with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate with a sense of urgency. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear, compelling technical presentations and influence customers and cross‑functional Native fluency in English and one Nordic language is required to effectively support customers, collaborate with local teams, and ensure successful implementation and ongoing engagement. Location requirement: Candidates must be currently based in one of the Nordic countries Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws. review_candidates.description: Description du poste IPREC - Formations IT recrute un·e technicien·ne informatique système et réseaux à temps plein en télétravail. Au quotidien, la personne en poste assure le support technique aux utilisateur·rices, prend en charge les incidents et enregistre les demandes via les outils de ticketing. Elle réalise la maintenance préventive et corrective des postes de travail, périphériques et équipements réseau, ainsi que l’installation, la configuration et la mise à jour des systèmes et logiciels. Le ou la technicien·ne participe au suivi de la sécurité (sauvegardes, antivirus, droits d’accès) et à la documentation des procédures. Le poste est entièrement à distance, avec collaboration en ligne avec les équipes pédagogiques et techniques. Qualifications Support utilisateur·rices : maîtrise du support technique, assistance à distance et gestion des demandes (Technical Support). Maintenance matérielle : compétences en maintenance informatique, diagnostic et réparation de postes et périphériques (Computer Maintenance, Computer Repair). Résolution d’incidents : capacité à identifier, analyser et résoudre les dysfonctionnements matériels et logiciels (Troubleshooting). Systèmes d’exploitation : bonne connaissance et administration des principaux OS (Windows, Linux, macOS) et de leurs outils (Operating Systems). Compétences complémentaires : notions de réseaux (TCP/IP, switch, Wi-Fi), sens du service, autonomie en télétravail, capacité à documenter les interventions et à travailler en équipe. Formation souhaitée : diplôme en informatique (Bac+2 de type BTS SIO, ou équivalent) et/ou expérience significative sur un poste similaire.
